graphnext.name: Samaneh Fekr // High-Scale Graph & Data Visualization
graphnext.category: Process Mining, Vector Graphs & Visual Engine
graphnext.tagline: Real-time process graph engine and data streaming pipeline with binary deserialization and locked 60FPS UI performance.
graphnext.overview: Samaneh Fekr is a production full-stack analytics platform engineered for process mining, enterprise network analysis, and rendering massive node graphs. The backend leverages Python, FastAPI, Polars, and PostgreSQL for instantaneous DFG matrix extraction, while the Next.js 16 frontend integrates Apache Arrow, MsgPack, and off-thread Web Worker layout computations to achieve stutter-free 60FPS visualization.
graphnext.architectureDetails: Fully containerized full-stack architecture with Docker Compose: Python 3 (FastAPI) backend powered by Polars, ConnectorX, and PyArrow over PostgreSQL. Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19 frontend integrating elkjs auto-layout inside Web Workers, @xyflow/react node canvas, D3-Sankey process flow diagrams, and isolated Zustand telemetry stores.
keyHighlights: Developed high-throughput Python backend pipelines with FastAPI & Polars for instant DFG graph and variant path extraction
Engineered parallel off-thread ELK graph layout calculations in Web Workers, guaranteeing zero UI frame drops
Implemented client-server binary data streaming using Apache Arrow, MsgPack, and Zstandard compression
Visualized enterprise process flows and throughput bottlenecks with custom D3-Sankey diagrams
Architected comprehensive Docker Compose infrastructure spanning Frontend, Backend, and PostgreSQL services

ascvd.name: ASCVD Cardiovascular Clinical Risk Engine
ascvd.tagline: 10-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk calculator based on ACC/AHA clinical guidelines with cloud persistence.
ascvd.overview: ASCVD is a precision clinical web application engineered for physicians to calculate 10-year risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. It translates multi-variable medical regression formulas into responsive multi-step forms with immediate client-side validation, tracking patient biomarkers (blood pressure, cholesterol, diabetes, age) with secure cloud audit logs and personalized clinical guidelines.
ascvd.architectureDetails: Built on Next.js 15 and React 19 with strict TypeScript 5 type-safety and HeroUI design system. Cloud PostgreSQL persistence on Supabase managed through Prisma ORM. Secure SMS-based authentication and session persistence via NextAuth.js, Bcrypt password hashing, and custom analytical risk gauge rendering.
keyHighlights: Implemented ACC/AHA 2013 pooled cohort equations with precision coefficient matrix mapping
Engineered smart multi-step clinical assessment forms with real-time biometric validation
Architected secure SMS one-time password (OTP) authentication and session lifecycle with NextAuth.js & Prisma
Automated clinical risk stratification with tailored therapeutic and lifestyle intervention recommendations
Designed historical timeline tracking to monitor longitudinal biomarker fluctuations on Supabase PostgreSQL
ascvd.visualPlaceholderSubtitle: Multi-step laboratory data entry forms and real-time clinical risk measurement gauges

salma-admin.tagline: Comprehensive clinical management portal for multi-tier plan structures, pathology profiles, dynamic Q&A, and supplements with React Compiler.

Built on HeroUI v3 and @heroui/styles, optimized Solar Icons, silky transitions powered by Motion, and robust multi-domain form state coordination via Zustand.

Hierarchical plan structure configuration engine with dynamic nutritional supplement allocation
Reusable generic CRUD foundation (data tables, responsive action headers, inline operations)
Leveraged HeroUI v3 alongside the React 19 Compiler for automated memoization and instant renders
Predictable decoupled state orchestration with Zustand and synchronized dark/light mode via next-themes

FeaturedCaseStudy.heading: Salma Health Platform & Clinical Plan Architecture
FeaturedCaseStudy.heroTitle: Frontend Architecture & System Engineering for Salma Clinical Dashboard
FeaturedCaseStudy.heroParagraph: Salma Admin is a scalable clinical management dashboard designed for medical specialists and operators. Engineered to configure multi-tier plan structures, pathology taxonomies, dynamic questionnaires, and supplement catalogs using HeroUI v3 and the React 19 Compiler.

overview.title: Product Overview & Scope
overview.subTitle: System Mission, Purpose & Clinical Scope
overview.text: Salma Admin Panel serves as the operational command center for medical practitioners to configure personalized clinical regimens, diagnostic questionnaires, disease registries, and supplement allocations. Built with clear domain boundaries and decoupled CRUD abstractions, the platform allows rapid feature expansion without regression risks.

challenge.title: Engineering Challenges
challenge.subTitle: Deep Form State Orchestration & UI Consistency
points: 1. Deeply Nested Form State: In planStructure.tsx and questions.tsx, regimens involve multi-tier dependencies, conditional branch logic, and dynamic supplement allocation. Orchestrating concurrent validation while preserving a fluid UI without superfluous re-renders was the primary architectural challenge.
2. Cross-System UI Uniformity: Establishing reusable, standardized CRUD primitives to manage tables, batch row actions, and page headers consistently across disparate clinical domains.

3. 60FPS Performance on Heavy Forms: Leveraging the official React 19 Compiler to automate component memoization and minimize render overhead without cluttering codebase ergonomics with manual useMemo hooks.

GraphNextCaseStudy.heading: Samaneh Fekr // High-Scale Graph & Data Flow Visualization
GraphNextCaseStudy.heroTitle: Full-Stack Architecture of Samaneh Fekr // Process Mining & Graph Analytics Engine
GraphNextCaseStudy.heroParagraph: Samaneh Fekr is a full-stack production platform for process mining and large-scale graph analysis; featuring a high-throughput backend pipeline built on FastAPI, Polars, PyArrow, and PostgreSQL paired with off-thread Web Worker layout rendering and interactive D3-Sankey flows in Next.js 16.

overview.title: Scope & Mission
overview.subTitle: Large-Scale Structured Data Visualization & Process Analysis
overview.text: Samaneh Fekr is engineered for real-time processing and interactive exploration of massive enterprise transaction networks. It empowers data analysts to inspect complex node topologies, D3-Sankey flow diagrams, edge duration histograms, and case distribution metrics at a steady 60 frames per second.

challenge.title: Big Data Challenges
challenge.subTitle: Backend Graph Computation & Frontend Render Bottlenecks
points: 1. Heavy Backend Graph Computation (DFG Generation): Extracting Directly Follows Graphs (DFG), recurring variant paths, duration bottlenecks, and transition matrices across millions of database logs in Python led to severe slowdowns with standard Pandas. This was resolved using the multi-threaded Polars columnar engine.

2. Network Transfer & JSON Serialization Bottleneck: Transmitting massive graph matrices as text JSON congested bandwidth and locked the main thread. Implementing Apache Arrow binary streaming, MsgPack serialization, and Zstandard compression reduced payload sizes by over 90%.

3. Stutter-Free Graph Auto-Layout: Calculating 2D coordinates for hundreds of interconnected nodes via ELK.js was offloaded to background Web Workers, preventing any frame loss on the browser UI thread.

sections.filterText: Hierarchical multi-level branch selector enabling analysts to isolate graph sub-topologies with zero UI freezing.

AboutPhilosophy.heading: Driving Motivation, Craft & Engineering Values
AboutPhilosophy.narrativeHeading: I view software engineering as the intersection of «complex systems problem-solving» and «60FPS visual precision».
AboutPhilosophy.narrativeText: What excites me in software development goes far beyond simply writing code: it is transforming intricate data structures, scalable workflows, and abstract ideas into a living, responsive, and resilient digital system. A remarkable product is born when clean architecture and data engineering unite with an uncompromising obsession for user ergonomics, tactile interactions, and bold visual identity.
steps: STEP 01 (Architecture & First Principles): Deeply understand problem fundamentals, design data pipelines, and map system topology before writing a single line of UI code.
STEP 02 (Modular Independence): Build bespoke design systems, resilient multi-step form state machines, and decoupled components free from unnecessary bloat.
STEP 03 (Uncompromising Performance): Optimize down to the binary level, delegate heavy workloads to Web Workers, and guarantee locked 60FPS UI fluidness.

principles.title: Data Architecture & Problem Solving Before Surface Design
principles.statement: An outstanding product never starts with superficial decoration; it is brought to life through rigorous problem understanding, scalable data architecture, and structural clarity.

principles.title: Engineering Elegance, Speed & Respect for User Time
principles.statement: Sub-millisecond render response, zero layout shift, and silky frame rates are how we respect the user's time. Genuine quality resides in the details that are felt rather than merely seen.

principles.title: Autonomy, Longevity & Hand-Crafted Design Systems
principles.statement: Clean codebases, maintainable structures, and components independent of brittle pre-packaged UI kits mark the defining line between a temporary prototype and an enduring product.
